تستهدفين (form X)
# تَسْتَهْدِفِينَ (tastahdifīna) /tas.tah.di.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَهْدَفَ (istahdafa)
# تُسْتَهْدَفِينَ (tustahdafīna) /tus.tah.da.fiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَهْدَفَ (istahdafa)
